parameters.text:
={{ 'You are Tusha Rahul Bellamkonda, an Applied AI Engineer.
Write a short, sweet, formal, and catchy cold outreach email to ' + (($json.Name || '').trim().split(' ')[0] || 'there') + ' (' + ($json.Title || 'Talent Acquisition') + ' at ' + ($json.Company || 'your company') + ').

Tool directive:
- First, use the "Search the web in Tavily" tool to search: "' + ($json.Company || 'company') + ' recent news AI cloud engineering projects".
- Identify 1 specific recent milestone, client project, or core tech focus to use in your opening hook.

Core requirements:
- Keep it SHORT & SWEET (under 65 words for the body).
- Focus entirely on what you can SOLVE and BUILD for ' + ($json.Company || 'their team') + ', NOT on what you need.
- Step 1 (Specific Hook): 1 sentence referencing their recent milestone or core tech focus discovered from search.
- Step 2 (Quantified Value): 1-2 sentences highlighting how you solve production AI challenges (e.g. improved enterprise RAG retrieval accuracy from 58% to 85% for 50+ users, and automated data pipelines cutting query times by 40% with Python and FastAPI).
- Step 3 (Low-friction CTA): 1 sentence asking if they are open to a brief 10-minute chat next week to explore how you can help accelerate their AI roadmap.

Rules:
- NEVER say "I am looking for a job", "I need an opportunity", "My name is", or "I hope this email finds you well".
- Never use bracket placeholders like [insert milestone] or [Your Name].
- Tone: Formal, polite, confident, and punchy.

Return ONLY valid JSON with two string keys: "subject" and "body".
Example format:
{
  "subject": "Accelerating AI initiatives at ' + ($json.Company || 'your company') + ' — Tusha",
  "body": "Hi ' + (($json.Name || '').trim().split(' ')[0] || 'there') + ',\n\nI've been following ' + ($json.Company || 'your company') + ''s recent work in scaling intelligent cloud solutions and wanted to reach out directly.\n\nAs teams deploy LLMs into production, retrieval accuracy and latency often become the main bottlenecks. In my work as an Applied AI Engineer, I built an enterprise RAG platform that improved retrieval accuracy from 58% to 85% for 50+ users, and automated data pipelines with Python and FastAPI cutting query times by 40%.\n\nWould you be open to a brief 10-minute chat next week to explore how I could help accelerate your team's AI roadmap?"
}' }}
